strings: As m_c grows, {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} knee starts to ache. r_c sighs and tells {PRONOUN/m_c/object} that {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/have/has} a bad knee.
m_c's knee always locks up and makes {PRONOUN/m_c/object} trip - {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/have/has} a bad knee.
m_c's parent had always assumed m_c's knee being painful was because {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/were/was} having growing pains. It turns out, m_c actually has a bad knee.
